message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about the maximum unemployment benefits in Massachusetts:

## Maximum Weekly Benefit Amount

As of **October 5, 2025**, the maximum weekly unemployment benefit in Massachusetts is **$1,105 per week** for the basic benefit. This increased from $1,051 due to a rise in the state's average weekly wage.

## With Dependent Allowances

Massachusetts also provides additional dependent allowances:
- **$25 per dependent child per week**
- Up to a maximum of **50% of your weekly benefit amount** in dependent allowances

This means with dependents, you could potentially receive more than the base $1,105 maximum. Some sources indicate the total maximum with dependency allowances can reach approximately **$1,105 or slightly higher** depending on how the dependent cap is calculated.

## Maximum Duration

Massachusetts offers:
- **Up to 26 weeks** of benefits under normal conditions
- **Up to 30 weeks** when the unemployment rate in any Massachusetts metropolitan area exceeds 5.1% (this extension was triggered in April 2025)

## Maximum Total Payout

With the 30-week maximum duration and highest weekly benefit, the total maximum payout can reach approximately **$33,150** (30 weeks × $1,105).

Massachusetts has the highest or among the highest unemployment benefits in the nation, with the longest duration (30 weeks during high unemployment periods) and one of the highest weekly maximums.
